hooks.name: Pre-commit quality gate
hooks.description: Runs lint, type check, tests, and ggshield secret scan before git commit/push

action.prompt: The user is about to execute a bash command. If this command is a git commit or git push operation, verify that: 1) ESLint passes (npm run lint in frontend/), 2) TypeScript compiles (tsc --noEmit in frontend/), 3) Tests pass (npx vitest run in frontend/). If this is a git push, also run 'ggshield secret scan pre-push' to check for leaked secrets. Only proceed if all checks pass. If this is not a git commit/push command, proceed normally without running checks.
